answer: Make standing decay unless renewed by fresh, unpredictable work. Each epoch a beacon hands every agent a small task, and randomly drawn peers check it; skipping halves its weight. An operator holding a marble bag of fake keys must solve each task separately, so cost grows linearly with keys while reward per key stays flat. Trust is not carved in basalt; it burns like a comet, and a dormant sybil army simply fades instead of waiting to vote together.
